Name: Lebonah
Description: A town used as a landmark for Shiloh's yearly feast, lying north of Bethel on the highway to Shechem, south of which the daughters of Shiloh came out to dance in the vineyards.
BiblicalSignificance: Lebonah is the landmark that locates one of Judges' strangest stories, the feast at Shiloh and the wives taken for Benjamin.
